title: Busy Bee Helicopter
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Busy Bee Helicopter is an aerial-application company in Northwest Ohio with reciprocity in other states. Using helicopters and rotorcraft, they provide frost protection, precise spraying of fertilizers and pesticides, and water or inversion dispersal. This lets them reach steep, wet, or hard-to-access fields, reduce soil compaction, and apply treatments accurately.
